card.name: Last part of the word interleukin
card.fires_on: The final piece "in" of the word interleukin, just before a hyphen and number such as -1, -2 or -6. It is seen in drug-label and immunology text.

modes.description: The ending "in" of interleukin, right before a hyphen and a number or an abbreviation in brackets.
